messages:
deploy-bot: Starting canary deploy v2026-03-21.1 -> prod. Traffic: 10% across eu-west.

maria: heads-up, please watch SLOs (p95, p99, 5xx) for the next 15m.

sam: pulling SLO dashboard https://dash.internal/redwood/slo?deploy=v2026-03-21.1 — p95 looks within target overall but embed-service 5xx jumped 0.2% -> 1.8% in the last 5m.

ingrid: seeing a cluster of 502s from embed-service: grpc timeout in traces, sample trace https://traces.redwood/trace/abcd1234

carol: @sam @ingrid can we route embed requests to the older model while we triage? suggest pin to model v3-2026-03-18 for embeds.

sam: quick data point: canary nodes show KV cache miss rate ~74% (vs 18% on baseline) — cold cache + batching optimizer could be amplifying latencies.

maria: that would explain cascading 502s from upstream.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic paused by request from @eng-platform at 1742501300 — reason: unusual 5xx spike on embed-service.

sam: proposed mitigation: apply route override for /embeds -> model:v3-2026-03-18 for canary buckets and keep traffic paused until metrics stabilize.

ingrid: +1. I'll stage rollback plan if override doesn't reduce 5xx. Patch I'm about to apply:

```
route.overrides['/embeds'] = 'model:v3-2026-03-18'
apply_override(canary_buckets)
// monitor: slo/embed_service/5xx
```

carol: if we pin, also disable the batching optimizer for embed workers (issue #ENG-4891) — that config can be toggled with:

```
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/embed-workers BATCH_OPTIMIZER=false
```

maria: ops-notify-bot please open an incident (label: deploy-canary-embed-5xx) and page on-call SRE.

ops-notify-bot: Incident created INC-2026-083: deploy-canary-embed-5xx — pager duty notified (on-call: eng-sre).

sam: override applied to canary buckets, kicking off warmup. watching metrics...

sam: 2m after override: p95 embed latency improved 320ms -> 110ms, 5xx dropped to 0.25%. KV cache hit rising.

ingrid: traces look clean, error traces from before the override all show grpc deadline exceeded. New traces show successful responses.

maria: decision: keep canary paused and pinned to the older model for /embeds. Continue monitoring for 10m; if 5xx remains < 0.5% we'll resume ramp. If > 0.5% -> full rollback.

carol: added note for release notes: "Canary paused and /embeds pinned to model v3-2026-03-18 due to transient 5xx spike; batching optimizer disabled for canary embed-workers. Follow-up: investigate cold-cache behavior and batching heuristics."

sam: consenting — will run a short cache-warm task to validate.

ops-notify-bot: Reminder scheduled: check stability at 1742501834 (10m).

maria: thanks all. I'll update the release checklist and close the loop after the 10m check. :thumbsup:
